## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): two-band structure on both carrier signs

Run 6 (`data/6`): electron side, n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², B 0→10 T. Run 7 (`data/7`): hole side, n = −1.2×10¹², riding 10→0.3 T. Calibration: run 5 (`hera_scratch/cal_run5.json`). Raw R_xx(B) first, then `sdh_onset` tone tables and FFTs in 1/B with the full-degeneracy Luttinger marks F_L = nh/4e.

**Read (lands the handoff gap — runs 6/7 were measured but never analyzed on the page):**
- **Electron (run 6):** oscillations persist to the 0.3 T record edge (light carriers). Two tone families: **F ≈ 7.1 T** with its 2×/3×/4× harmonic ladder, and **F ≈ 30 T** (dominant above 3 T, own harmonic ladder at 60/90/120 T). Sum 7.1 + 30 ≈ 37 T vs F_L = 33.1 T — Luttinger-consistent two-band partition to within ~12% (inside the geometry-prior calibration uncertainty).
- **Hole (run 7):** multi-tone: ~4.7–5.3 T dominant below ~2 T, 6.6 / 8.5 / 12.3 T tracked, FFT above 3 T peaking at ~12.9 T ≈ F_L = 12.4 T. Near-CNP: tones close, harmonic/fundamental assignment ambiguous at a single density.
- **Take:** two incommensurate frequency families on the electron side and multi-tone holes ⇒ **multiple Fermi surfaces at D = 0 on both signs — leans ABAB (Bernal), disfavors single-band ABCA**; not yet a call. A single-n FFT can't separate fundamentals from harmonics/breakdown or give the degeneracy partition — that is the Landau fan's job (plan step 4).

# SdH spot checks, runs 6 (e: n=+3.2e12) & 7 (h: n=-1.2e12), D = 0 — raw + onset tones + FFT
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_fft, sdh_onset, luttinger_frequency, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 8))
for i, (rid, label, n_SI) in enumerate([(6, "electron n=+3.2e12", +3.2e16), (7, "hole n=-1.2e12", -1.2e16)]):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    chans = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    I = np.abs(r.col("sr0_X") / chans["sr0"].gain)
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / chans["sr1"].gain) / I
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    o = np.argsort(B); Bs, Rs = B[o], R[o]
    m = Bs > 0.25; Bs, Rs = Bs[m], Rs[m]
    fs_R = float(r.meta["measurement_config"].get("sr1_sensitivity", 50e-6)) / np.median(I)
    F_L = luttinger_frequency(np.array([n_SI]))[0]

    ax[i, 0].plot(Bs, Rs, lw=0.6)
    ax[i, 0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="R_xx (Ω)", title=f"run {rid} — {label} (raw)")

    print(f"=== run {rid} ({label}): F_L = {F_L:.1f} T, R fs {fs_R:.0f} Ω ===")
    try:
        print(sdh_onset(Rs, Bs, r_full_scale=fs_R).summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("SdhOnsetError:", e)

    for j, blo in enumerate([1.5, 3.0]):
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(Rs[:, None], Bs, b_range=(blo, Bs.max()), nfft=4096)
        sp = spec[0]
        a = ax[i, 1 + j]
        a.plot(freqs, sp / sp.max())
        a.axvline(F_L, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {F_L:.1f} T")
        a.set(xlim=(0, 60), xlabel="F (T)", title=f"run {rid} FFT in 1/B, B > {blo} T")
        a.legend(fontsize=8)
        pk, _ = find_peaks(sp, height=sp.max() * 0.05, distance=8)
        top = sorted(zip(sp[pk], freqs[pk]))[::-1][:6]
        print(f"  FFT peaks (B>{blo} T): " + ", ".join(f"{f:.1f} T" for _, f in top if f > 1))
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.25 → +3.20×10¹², B 0.5 → 10 T

> **05:27** · landau-fan D=0: n fast -1.25..+3.20e12 131 pts (co-swept Vtg -0.291..+0.984 / Vbg -0.484..+1.166 V); B slow 0.5->10 T ascending, 133 rows uniform-1/B (Nyq 25 T <1.3 T / 52 T above); sr1 100 uV; fast\_delay 0.7 s; leak guard 1 nA · **ETA ~11:17** (≈5h50m)

**Plan step 4** (operator-requested; `hera_scratch/plan.md`). Runs 6/7 (ana cell 15) show multi-band SdH on both carrier signs — e-side F ≈ 7.1 + ~30 T (sum 37 vs F_L 33.1), h-side tones 4.7–12.9 T — but a single-n FFT can't separate fundamentals from harmonics/breakdown or give the degeneracy partition. The fan's per-column F(n) slopes and the ν-gap wedges are the ABAB/ABCA/ABCB discriminant.

**Geometry.** Fast axis: n = −1.25 → +3.20×10¹² cm⁻² through the CNP, 131 pts (Δn = 0.034), co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line — V_tg −0.291→+0.984 V, V_bg −0.484→+1.166 V, all inside the committed validators. Slow axis: B ascending 0.5 → 10 T (magnet reads ~0, state0), **two-segment uniform-1/B grid, 133 rows**: Δ(1/B) = 0.0199 below 1.3 T (Nyquist 25 T — only tones ≤ 13 T are alive there, margin against harmonic aliasing) and 0.0096 above (Nyquist 52 T — covers the 30 T family + harmonics). Per-column ΔF = 1/(1/0.5 − 1/10) = 0.53 T.

**Coverage trade:** the hole side ends at n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V validator) — the fan is e-side-rich by construction; full hole coverage does not exist inside the committed box. D ≠ 0 is not covered here (step 6 candidate, riding 10 T down).

**Sensitivity trade (stated):** sr1 at 100 µV (10 kΩ FS at 10 nA). The gapped CNP columns at high B may soft-clip (>10.9 kΩ) — accepted: a ν = 0 rail is itself a read, and the SdH evidence lives in the metallic columns, where 100 µV keeps the readback resolution the oscillations need (session-notes rail lesson, run 4).

**Dwell (bent knowingly):** fast_delay 0.7 s ≈ 2.3τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct) — a uniform ~1-pt lag along n, shifts all columns equally, F(n) slopes untouched (same argument as run 5's 3.3τ). Reads ≈ 0.1 s/pt async (measured, run 5: 1.098 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0).

**Price (honest):** 133 rows × (131 × 0.8 s + 6.5 s turnaround) ≈ 4.1 h + field 9.5 T @ 0.137 T/min = 69 min + 133 × 3 s settle + first ramp ≈ 1.3 h → 5.4 h; +7 % session-measured overrun → **≈ 5 h 50 m**, ending at **10 T, gates at the n = +3.2×10¹² end** (next step rides the field down — never re-traverse).

**Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed on `data --next --follow`): first 2 rows — signal level, no rail across the metallic range, gate currents at pA floor, T stable; then hourly digests; interim analysis at row ~63 (B = 1.3 T: apex + hole-side wedges visible?) and row ~101 (B ≈ 2.5 T: partial per-column FFT — two dispersing branches?). Abort (`nb-collab interrupt`) on: sustained gate current > 1 nA (in-cell guard also trips), wide-range railing, T_sample excursion > 1.6 K, or a featureless map by 2.5 T. Partial data keeps.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): n fast -1.25..+3.20e12 (131), B slow 0.5 -> 10 T (133 rows, uniform-1/B x2 segments) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.02: fan starts at 0.5), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.02 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- fast axis: D = 0 line, n = -1.25 .. +3.20e12 cm^-2, 131 pts (dn = 0.034e12) ---
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.20, 131)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX
print(f"fast axis: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (131), Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V")

# --- slow axis: B ascending 0.5 -> 10 T, uniform in 1/B, two segments ---
invB = np.unique(np.hstack((np.linspace(1/0.5, 1/1.3, 63),    # d(1/B)=0.0199, Nyquist 25 T (B < 1.3 T)
                            np.linspace(1/1.3, 1/10.0, 71)))) # d(1/B)=0.0096, Nyquist 52 T
B_vec = np.round(1.0 / invB[::-1], 5)                          # ascending 0.5 -> 10 T, 133 rows
assert B_vec[0] == 0.5 and B_vec[-1] <= B_SESSION_CAP and len(B_vec) == 133

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 0.7, 3.0   # 0.7 s ~ 2.3 tau (tau 0.3 s / 24 dB) - uniform lag, slopes untouched
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# Fixed sensitivity: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA; gapped-CNP columns at high B may rail - accepted, stated in md.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, "
      f"slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan D=0: n fast -1.25..+3.20e12 (131), B slow 0.5->10 T uniform-1/B 2-seg (133 rows), "
                  "Vsi = 0, sr1 100 uV, cal run 5")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: n -1.25..+3.20e12 cm^-2 131 pts (dn 0.034e12), co-swept Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} / '
              f'Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; B 0.5->10 T ascending, 133 rows uniform-1/B '
              f'(d(1/B) 0.0199 below 1.3 T / 0.0096 above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; after runs 6/7 spot checks')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, magnet.field, sr1.X)          # the fan, live
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# no park: field stays at 10 T, gates at the n = +3.2e12 end - the next step rides the field down.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, "
      f"T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
